group_entry.natural_language_proof_strategy: The precondition owns an uninitialized byte buffer and every descriptor field required by the postcondition. The requested bound 4..256 makes the four-byte-rounded capacity positive and at most 256; the cast does not wrap. The descriptor values already encode readidx=writeidx=b_status=0, head at the buffer, tail one aligned capacity past it, and the operations pointer. Converting undef_full to mixed_full yields exactly repeat None, so the canonical logical state is the empty FIFO and all postcondition resources are present.
group_entry.grouping_reason: The current cleaned manual contains exactly one target witness. It is a single success-return resource-packaging obligation, so one group is permitted by the 12-witness bound and avoids an artificial dependency boundary.
